user.title: Measurements
user.description: Choose the sensors the building model learns from. Their hourly statistics in the recorder are used for training.

data_description.room_sensors: Rooms heated by this circuit. The controller uses their mean.
data_description.supply_sensor: The actual flow temperature of the floor heating circuit, after the mixing valve.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: A reliable outdoor temperature, ideally a mean of several sensors.
data_description.weather_entity: Needs an hourly forecast. Without it the current outdoor temperature is held.
data_description.price_sensor: A sensor with an hourly price list in its attributes (EPEX Spot, Nord Pool, Tibber, ...).

control.title: Actuator
control.description: How the calculated supply set point reaches your heating. The integration starts in shadow mode and only writes once you turn on the switch "Control active".

data_description.target_entity: Offset: the offset number. Absolute: a number or input_number for the set point. Climate: the climate entity of the supply controller.
data_description.setpoint_sensor: Required for the offset mode: the supply set point the heating uses, including the offset.
data_description.enable_entity: Control only while this entity is on (or heat). Otherwise the controller pauses.

error.rooms_required: Choose at least one room sensor.
error.target_not_climate: The climate mode needs a climate entity.
error.target_not_number: This mode needs a number or input_number entity.
error.setpoint_required: The offset mode needs the effective set point sensor.

data.offset_reset: Offset when control is handed back

data_description.horizon: Hours the controller looks ahead. Should be well above the reaction time of the floor.
data_description.train_days: Days of recorder statistics used to learn the model. Retrained every night.
data_description.offset_reset: Value the offset is set to when the switch is turned off or the integration is unloaded.

error.target_not_number: This mode needs a number or input_number entity.
